dedupe_keys.name: ogc citygml conceptual model and exchange format for 3d city models

description: CityGML is the Open Geospatial Consortium standard defining a conceptual model and exchange format for representing, storing and exchanging virtual 3D city models, covering terrain, buildings, infrastructure, vegetation, topology and semantics. Version 3.0 is published in two parts, Part 1 the Conceptual Model Standard (OGC 20-010) and Part 2 the GML Encoding Standard (OGC 21-006r2), both listed as downloads on the standard page, which was last modified in February 2026. Coverage: any city or region; national 3D building models in several countries use it. Access: standard documents on the OGC website. Licence: OGC standards are free to download. Caveats: the GML encoding is verbose, which is why the JSON encoding CityJSON exists, and levels of detail and attributes differ between datasets that claim CityGML. Simulation uses are the common data model for 3D building stock in urban energy, solar, noise and flood models and in city digital twins. Related records: CityJSON, 3DCityDB and the 3D building datasets in this piece such as the Enugu LoD1 model and Munich CityGML solar potential.
